##### Project general facts

Trump Tower Jeddah is a residential tower developed by DarGlobal. Designed by Gensler Architects, the tower rises 47 floors, arranged across a north wing and a south wing. The collection includes 1-, 2-, 3- & 4-bedroom apartments and 3- & 4-bedroom penthouse residences. The project is positioned as a high-end address combining contemporary architecture with an elevated standard of luxury living.

Residents have access to the Trump Members Club, a private club within the tower featuring a cigar lounge, a restaurant and bar with private dining rooms, and a bar lounge with a dedicated meeting room. Wellness facilities include a spa, a yoga zone, and a 24-hour fitness center with a changing room, alongside a pool complex comprising a main swimming pool, a kids' beach pool, a jacuzzi, and cabanas. A residential reception and scenic lift serve the club levels.

Interiors feature double-glazed windows throughout, with marble flooring in the foyer and in the living and dining areas, complemented by painted walls with accent wood paneling or wallpaper in selected areas and gypsum ceilings finished in paint. Kitchens are fitted with marble-look porcelain slab tiles, an engineered stone countertop and backsplash, laminate-finished cabinets, and Smeg appliances including a built-in fridge, oven, cooker, hood, and dishwasher. Bedrooms feature marble-look porcelain flooring and built-in lacquered joinery, while bathrooms are finished with porcelain tiling, an engineered stone countertop, and European sanitaryware with mirror. The residences are delivered unfurnished.


##### Location description and benefits

Jeddah Corniche is one of the most iconic and sought-after waterfront destinations in Jeddah, stretching along the Red Sea coastline and offering a vibrant blend of leisure, lifestyle, and scenic beauty. Known for its open spaces, sea views, and beautifully landscaped promenades, it creates a unique coastal atmosphere that combines relaxation with urban energy. The area has become a central hub for both residents and visitors seeking a premium seaside experience.

The Corniche is defined by its wide range of attractions, including parks, walking and cycling paths, public beaches, and a variety of cafés and restaurants overlooking the sea. Landmarks such as King Fahd Fountain add to its identity, while nearby luxury hotels and entertainment venues enhance its appeal as a lifestyle destination. The area is especially popular for outdoor activities, family outings, and social gatherings.

Jeddah Corniche also benefits from excellent connectivity to key districts across the city, including proximity to King Abdulaziz International Airport and major roads like King Abdulaziz Road. With its prime waterfront setting, continuous development, and strong demand, it remains one of the most prestigious and desirable locations for living and investment in Jeddah.
